A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SpargeAttention research work. All 17 pages, including Appendix A.1–A.4, are readable; the text, equations, tables, and rendered figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v6 reports original language, image, and video generation evaluations, latency measurements, ablations, and sparsity analyses in Section 4 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v7 retains those original empirical results, including Tables 1–11 and the appendix evaluations and sparsity analyses.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 corrects two stated update steps: line 13 restores the previous-normalizer multiplier, and line 16 removes an erroneous inverse from the output-rescaling matrix. These localized pseudocode corrections align with the existing Equation (1); the filtering, quantization, and permutation procedures are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six language, image, and video models using WikiText, LongBench, InfiniteBench, Needle-in-a-Haystack, COCO annotations, and open-sora prompts. Appendix task coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 11 retain the same Full Attention, MInference, and FlexPrefill comparisons. Table 2 and Figure 10 also retain their corresponding dense and quantized attention comparators; no comparator membership changes.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same model configurations, sequence lengths, metrics, error thresholds, block sizes, and evaluation procedures. No experiment or evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The permutation and self-similarity ablations, mask-contribution analysis, prediction-overhead measurements, sequence-length analysis, and diffusion sparsity analyses are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting and averaging practices are unchanged. Appendix A.2 retains the same threshold-based case selection and statistical-significance wording; no run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 retains Mochi latency of 1037 seconds, and Table 1 retains Llama3.1 SpargeAttn results of 708.1 TOPS and 0.909 NIAH accuracy at 128K.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1 restores l(i,j-1) in the normalizer recurrence and changes the output multiplier from diag(exp(...)) inverse to diag(exp(...)). These algebraic corrections resolve inconsistencies with Equation (1) and Section 3.4. Other definitions, equations, and mathematical arguments are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims of universal, training-free sparse and quantized attention, two-stage filtering, and acceleration across language, image, and video models without sacrificing end-to-end metrics.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same explanations of long-context performance, self-similarity robustness, permutation tradeoffs, and sparsity variation across layers, heads, and timesteps. No substantive interpretation, applicability boundary, or limitation is added.

D1.justification: The implementation pseudocode in Algorithm 1 now gives consistent accumulation and rescaling instructions at lines 13 and 16, improving reproducibility from the document. CUDA details, hyperparameters, hardware, block sizes, and code-access statements remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, reference list, and novelty positioning are unchanged. No prior work is added, removed, or substantively recharacterized.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes from v6, 13 August 2025, to v7, 1 October 2025. Body prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–17 and Tables 1–11 retain their displays, captions, structure, and placement. The corrected formulas remain within the same Algorithm 1 display; no substantive visual or layout revision occurs.

improvement.justification: v7 fixes two mathematically consequential pseudocode errors in Algorithm 1, bringing its normalizer accumulation and output rescaling into agreement with Equation (1), already correct in v6. This improves internal consistency and implementation guidance. The empirical evidence, claims, and appendices remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
